paper.title: BindGPT: A Scalable Framework for 3D Molecular Design via Language Modeling and Reinforcement Learning

result.summary: BindGPT 是一个将 3D 分子设计表述为文本生成的语言模型框架，用结构 SMILES 与空间 XYZ 格式联合描述分子图与原子坐标，从而无需外部软件重建分子图 [S1.p5][S3.SS1.p2]。模型在 Uni-Mol 的大规模 3D 分子与口袋数据上预训练，并在 CrossDocked、GEOM-DRUGS 上监督微调，再用外部对接软件的奖励进行强化学习 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。实验表明，单个预训练语言模型可同时充当 3D 分子生成模型、给定分子图的构象生成器以及口袋条件 3D 分子生成器 [abstract]，在多个任务上达到与专门扩散模型、语言模型和图神经网络相当或更好的表现，且采样成本低约两个数量级 [abstract]。作者认为这显示大规模预训练范式可以从 NLP 有效迁移到 3D 药物发现 [S5.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是如何用语言模型统一处理 3D 分子设计，包括 3D 分子生成、给定分子图的构象生成以及口袋条件分子生成 [S1.p3][S1.p5]。原文指出，多数空间分子生成器只关注原子类型和位置，依赖 OpenBabel 等外部工具重建化学键，而原子位置的微小偏差可能显著改变重建的分子图甚至使其断裂 [S1.p2]。此外，3D 分子生成在语言模型方法中受到的关注有限 [S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: However, it’s noteworthy that most spatial molecular generators focus exclusively on atom types and locations.

This reliance can introduce vulnerabilities, as the precision required for atom placement means that minor positional adjustments can significantly alter reconstructed molecular bonds or even make the molecular graph disconnected.
In this work, we introduce a novel framework that applies language modeling to the domain of 3D molecular data represented by textual tokens.
We introduce BindGPT, a Language Model for handling spatial molecular structures in text format.
However, the challenge of 3D molecule generation has received limited attention in language model approach.

method.text: 方法的核心思想是用自回归 token 生成模型把多种 3D 小分子设计任务统一表述为带提示的文本生成，将条件 token 放在待生成对象 token 之前 [S3.p1]。模型采用 decoder-only 的 GPT-NeoX 架构并使用旋转位置嵌入以支持长度泛化 [S3.SS1.p1]。表示上把 XYZ 格式与 SMILES 格式耦合，强制两者原子顺序一致，并从 XYZ 中移除原子符号，从而无需外部软件重建分子图 [S3.SS1.p2]。训练流程包括在 3D 分子与口袋数据上的预训练、在 CrossDocked 等数据上的监督微调，以及使用 REINFORCE 和外部对接软件奖励的强化学习微调 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: The key idea of our method is utilizing an autoregressive token generation model, influenced by GPT-based models, to solve several 3D small molecule generation tasks in one simple yet flexible paradigm.
The main principle in our approach is to formulate several 3D molecular design task as prompted generation of text.

In our work we follow the decoder-only paradigm in Language Models and use the GPT-NeoX 1 1 1 Despite other architectures existing today (such as LLaMa2), our main focus was building a general framework of working with 3D molecules that can work with any Language Model architecture. architecture that utilizes rotary position embeddings.
To alleviate that, we propose to couple the XYZ format with the SMILES format.
To align these two formats we enforce to have the same atom ordering in both.

In this work, we aim to leverage insights accumulated by the NLP community in the paradigm of Large Language Models: pretraining-finetuning, prompting, scaling, finetuning with Reinforcement Learning, tool use, etc..
During the supervised fine-tuning phase, we continue model training on CrossDocked 2020, which is a high-quality dataset containing aligned pocket-ligand pairs.
We apply the REINFORCE algorithm for further model finetuning.

experiments.text: 预训练使用 Uni-Mol 提出的大规模 3D 分子数据集，包含 208M 个构象、12M 个分子和 3.2M 个蛋白质口袋空间结构 [S4.p2]。口袋条件生成任务在 CrossDocked 上微调，作者过滤后得到约 27M 个口袋-配体对，覆盖 14k 分子与 3k 口袋的交叉组合，并留出 100 个口袋用于评估 [S4.p2]。3D 分子与 3D 构象生成任务在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调，该数据集包含 300k 分子的 27M 个构象，并以 Platinum 数据集作为零样本构象生成的留出评估集 [S4.p2]。评估指标包括有效性、SA、QED、Lipinski、分布度量、RMSD、RMSD-coverage 以及生成 1K 个有效 3D 分子的时间 [S4.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: For pretraining, we use a large 3D molecular dataset proposed by the authors of the Uni-Mol model.
The dataset contains 208M conformations for 12M molecules and 3.2M spatial structures of protein pockets.
For finetuning in the pocket-conditioned generation task, we use the aforementioned CrossDocked dataset which contains aligned pocket-molecule pairs.
Our filtration of the dataset has around 27M pocket-ligand pairs covering a cross product of 14k molecules with 3k pockets
We also hold out a set of 100 pockets from the training data for evaluating the model performance.
For the tasks of 3D molecule and 3D conformer generation (Section 4.1), to make comparisons with baselines more fair, we also finetune the model on the GEOM-DRUGS dataset
Finally, we use the Platinum dataset as a hold-out evaluation dataset to test our model and baselines on zero-shot conformer generation.

We provide the validity ( $\uparrow$) of generated molecules and druglikeness metrics - SA ( $\uparrow$), QED ( $\uparrow$), and Lipinski ( $\uparrow$) that are agnostic to 3D but measure how likely the molecule to be a drug.
Finally, we measure the time needed to generate 1K valid 3D molecules on one GPU.

findings.text: 预训练的 BindGPT 在无显式氢和有显式氢两种设置下都持续优于 XYZ-TF 基线，并且是首个能在如此大规模下显式建模氢的模型 [S4.SS1.p3]。在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调后，BindGPT 在几乎所有分布评估指标上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，但在 druglikeness 上未超过 MolDiff [S4.SS1.p3]。在构象生成任务中，BindGPT 借助 RDKit 工具时能匹配 Torsional Diffusion 的表现，不借助时存在小差距，而 Uni-Mol 未能泛化到 Platinum 数据集 [S4.SS1.p3]。在口袋条件生成任务中，经 RL 微调的模型能更高效地搜索结合分子空间，并在结合能上显著优于此前最佳基线 [S4.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: First, the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
BindGPT is the first model capable of modeling hydrogen explicitly at such large scale.
Next, for the methods trained on the GEOM-DRUGS dataset, BindGPT (being finetuned on this data) shows state-of-the-art performance scores for nearly all distributional evaluation metrics.
Even though BindGPT does not outperform MolDiff in Druglikeness, that could be explained by a smaller vocabulary of the, containing only frequent atoms.
BindGPT, in contrast, is capable of matching the performance of TD when assisted by the RDKit tool and having a small gap when not.
Surprisingly, Uni-Mol fails to generalize to this new dataset (even assisted by RDKit), which we think is because of its structural diversity.

Our main conclusion is that the RL finetuned model can learn to search the space of binding molecules much more efficiently and significantly outperforms all the previous best baselines in terms of the binding energy.
